Set up your company

Answer these steps in any order. Your answers are saved as you go, so you can leave and come back. Nothing changes until you review and apply.

DNS

Create these records at your DNS provider so your domain and modules reach this server.

Module addresses are listed once company.yaml puts them on the internet. With dns.provider: cloudflare, can up creates these records; otherwise add them yourself.

DNS
NameTypeValueFor
acme.exampleA203.0.113.7site
admin.acme.exampleA203.0.113.7admin
web.acme.exampleA203.0.113.7web pages

Instant URL

Until DNS is set up, the site is reachable on an sslip.io address that points at this server.

https://203-0-113-7.sslip.io Answering

sslip.io is an external, volunteer-run service; if it is down the instant URL does not work, but your server is not affected.
